applications.intro: Conversations that came on WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram or another app, not by phone. Record one here; your own are listed under App logs.
applications.numberHint: Type the number; the customer is looked up as soon as you pause
applications.timeHint: HH:mm, today. Set it back if the customer wrote earlier.
applications.formUnavailable: The Applications form could not be loaded at sign-in, so the message will be recorded without a classification. Sign out and in again to fetch it.
applications.readOnly: Written on an earlier day, so it can no longer be changed. Ask a supervisor.
applications.empty: Record a message on the left; it appears here at once.
applications.offline: The server could not be reached - your messages are unavailable right now.

errors.noChannel: Choose which app the message came on.
errors.badTimeFormat: Enter the time as HH:mm, for example 14:30.
errors.formIncomplete: The classification is half filled in: complete it, or clear the type to record the message unclassified.
errors.offline: The server could not be reached, so the message was not recorded. What you typed is kept: press Record again once it is back.
errors.unknown_channel: That app is no longer offered. Pick another, or refresh.
errors.phone_channel: A phone conversation is a call, and calls are logged on their own.
errors.bad_time: The time must be today and not in the future. Ask a supervisor for another day.
errors.classification_refused: The classification was refused - the form may have changed. Refresh and try again.

call.notesHeading: The customer didn't answer. Add a note?

callLog.intro: Your recent calls — the last 100, newest first. Only yours: no agent sees another agent’s calls.
callLog.emptyHint: Calls appear here as soon as they end.
callLog.offline: The server could not be reached - your call log is unavailable right now.
callLog.notesHeadingNoAnswer: Why didn't this call go through?

recording.available: Recorded - open the call to listen
recording.none: This call has no recording. If it has only just ended, the recording may still be uploading - refresh in a minute.
recording.expired: This call was recorded, and the recording was deleted when its retention period ended.
recording.notYours: This recording belongs to another agent's call.
recording.offline: The recording could not be fetched - the server could not be reached.
recording.unreadable: The recording arrived but could not be played. Tell your supervisor.
recording.noDevice: The recording could not be played - no speaker or headset was found.
recording.onCall: Paused while you are on a call. Play it again once the call ends.

caller.notChecked: Could not check who this is
caller.saveOffline: The server could not be reached, so the customer was not saved. What you typed is kept: press Save again once it is back.

classification.heading: Classify this call
classification.saveFailed: It could not be saved. Try again.
classification.tooOld: This call can no longer be changed. Ask a supervisor.
classification.typeNotOffered: This form no longer offers that type. Pick another one.
classification.notYours: That call belongs to another agent.

contacts.searchHint: Search by name, address or phone number
contacts.name: Name
contacts.offline: The server could not be reached - contacts are unavailable right now.
contacts.sameName: There are already contacts with this name

errors.duplicate_number: That number already belongs to another contact.
errors.server_error: Could not save. Please try again.

contacts.intro: Find a customer, or add one. The list is shared by every agent.
contacts.emptyHint: Search by name or number, or add a new contact.

delivery.intro: Which branch delivers to a place, and what delivery costs. Set by your supervisor.
delivery.searchHint: Type part of the place name
delivery.emptyHint: Type part of a place name to see its branch and delivery price.
delivery.noMatches: That place is not on the list.
delivery.offline: The server could not be reached - delivery prices are unavailable right now.

dial.heading: Dial a number
dial.intro: Ring a customer directly. The call is logged and classified like any other.
dial.phoneNotReady: The phone is not registered, so no call can be placed.

home.doNotDisturbHint: Calls are turned away without ringing, and offered to another agent.
home.autoAnswerHint: Calls are picked up as soon as they arrive, without pressing Answer.
home.noExtension: No extension configured — ask your supervisor

errors.invalid_credentials: The username or password is not correct.
errors.account_disabled: This account has been disabled. Ask your supervisor to re-enable it.
errors.server_unreachable: The server could not be reached. Check the network.
errors.server_error: The server reported an error. Please try again.
errors.not_an_agent: This is a supervisor account. Supervisors use the web app in the browser.
errors.signed_out: You have been signed out. Your account was changed or your sign-in ran out. Please sign in again.

menu.intro: What is on the menu, what is in it and what it costs. Set by your supervisor.
menu.searchHint: Type part of an item name, or something in it
menu.emptyHint: Type part of an item name to see its price and contents.
menu.noMatches: Nothing on the menu matches that.
menu.offline: The server could not be reached - the menu is unavailable right now.

appLogs.intro: Your own application conversations: today's can be edited, older ones are read only.
